# Event text production observations

[Русская версия](README.ru.md). English is authoritative.

[provenance.json](provenance.json) identifies the pinned QD revision, exact Java/compiler/harness/launcher hashes, production-class inventory and result hashes. [oracle.tsv](oracle.tsv) contains 182957 actual observations of existing production methods, captured with Java 25. The separate Java 8 capture is retained with full working evidence; [numeric-version-differences.tsv](numeric-version-differences.tsv) preserves both observed spellings and exact per-case decimal-selection proof.

Inputs include deterministic seeded binary64 values; every exponent with boundary significands; positive/negative subnormals; neighboring values around decimal powers; signed zero, NaN and infinities; every UTF-16 unit; all declared market enum names; exact nullable/custom/built-in source names; raw flag words; full Quote/Profile/Trade/TradeETH/Summary default/filled and raw-flag events; and signed64/date-boundary timestamps. Explicit profiles include UTC, offsets +19800000/-27000000/1234/-2147483648/2147483647 milliseconds and three locales. Eight named profiles add America/New_York, Europe/Berlin, Asia/Kathmandu, Australia/Lord_Howe, Europe/Dublin, Pacific/Apia, SystemV/EST5EDT and Asia/Tokyo. Their 1296 observations were also captured independently with Java 8 and were byte-identical to Java 25.

Rows contain profile, kind, input, result. Scalar results are exact ASCII; complete event/source strings use lowercase four-digit UTF-16 hex units separated by commas. Literal NUL and malformed UTF-16 survive capture without platform transcoding. The [three cache exceptions](upstream-cache-differences.tsv) contain exact cached and fresh-instance Java results; all other rows remain strict.

This finite corpus is not exhaustive over all binary64/signed64 inputs and does not establish unimplemented event leaves or equivalence of arbitrary timezone datasets. Named C++ contexts use the separately qualified IANA 2026f profile; the [36 classified provider dataset differences](../schedule-query/tzdb2026f-provenance.json) remain separate from the three formatter-cache exceptions. See [validation](../../conformance/EVENT-TEXT-VALIDATION.md), the [tool](../../../tools/upstream/event-text-oracle/README.md) and [reference decision](../../../docs/decisions/ADR-0011-java-event-text-reference.md).
